title: Cerebus the Aardvark #152 1991 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics Mothers & Daughters 2
descriptionText:
Cerebus the Aardvark #152, published in 1991 by Aardvark-Vanaheim, is a must-have for fans of the iconic character and the Copper Age of comics. This issue, titled "Mothers & Daughters, Part 2," continues the captivating story that has been followed by readers for years. The comic book is a softcover, English language edition and features art by the talented duo, Dave Sim and Gerhard.

This comic book is a great addition to any collection and comes boarded and with a dust jacket for added protection. It is perfect for enthusiasts of adventure, animal, fantasy, and fiction genres. Don't miss your chance to own this vintage piece of US Comics tradition.
